name: Ivory Coast

flag.description: Three vertical stripes of orange (hoist), white and green.
flag.symbolism: Orange represents the savanna of the north, white peace and unity, and green hope and the forests of the south.

hook: Ivory Coast is Ireland in a mirror: orange savanna at the flagpole, green coastal forest at the fly, while Ireland starts with green.
trivia: Besides the reversed colour order, Ivory Coast's flag is shorter than Ireland's: proportions 2:3 against Ireland's 1:2.
Ivory Coast is the world's largest producer of cocoa beans.
Yamoussoukro's Basilica of Our Lady of Peace is among the largest churches in the world.
